mcqs.question: Which of the following statements reflects a common misconception about physical and chemical properties?

options.A: Melting point of a substance is a chemical property.
options.C: Reactivity with acid is a chemical property.
options.D: Color of a substance is a physical property.

mcqs.answer: Melting point of a substance is a chemical property.
mcqs.explanation: Melting point describes the temperature at which a substance changes state from solid to liquid without changing its chemical composition, so it is a physical property. Therefore statement A is a misconception. The other statements correctly identify density, acid reactivity, and color as physical or chemical properties as appropriate.

mcqs.question: Which process below best illustrates a chemical change rather than a physical change?

options.B: Burning a magnesium ribbon in air

mcqs.answer: Burning a magnesium ribbon in air
mcqs.explanation: Burning magnesium reacts with oxygen to form magnesium oxide, a new substance with different chemical composition, which is a chemical change. Dissolving sugar, melting ice, and crushing glass involve no change in chemical identity, so they are physical changes.

mcqs.learning_point: Classify matter into elements, compounds and mixtures
mcqs.question: Select the option that correctly classifies each of the three given samples as an element, a compound, or a mixture.

options.A: (i) Pure oxygen gas – element; (ii) Table salt (NaCl) – compound; (iii) Air – mixture
options.B: (i) Table salt – element; (ii) Air – compound; (iii) Pure copper – mixture
options.C: (i) Air – element; (ii) Water – mixture; (iii) Carbon dioxide – compound
options.D: (i) Pure iron – compound; (ii) Sand – element; (iii) Milk – mixture

mcqs.answer: (i) Pure oxygen gas – element; (ii) Table salt (NaCl) – compound; (iii) Air – mixture
mcqs.explanation: Pure oxygen consists of only O₂ molecules, making it an element. Table salt is composed of sodium and chlorine chemically bonded, so it is a compound. Air contains several gases (N₂, O₂, Ar, etc.) that are not chemically combined, thus it is a mixture. The other options misclassify at least one sample.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a heterogeneous mixture?

options.A: A solution of common salt in water
options.C: A mixed salad containing lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers

mcqs.answer: A mixed salad containing lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers
mcqs.explanation: In a heterogeneous mixture the different components are visibly distinct and not uniformly distributed, as in a salad. A salt solution, air, and brass are homogeneous mixtures where the composition is uniform throughout.
